cpu: Intel Core i7-9750H, 6 physical cores / 12 logical CPUs
hash_scheme: SHA256 of sorted relative .py path, NUL, and file bytes for the imported package
scope: All candidates after safe preparation; no candidate cap; duration refinement disabled
budgets: seconds is the full event-model fallback budget, not an end-to-end deadline. Master up to 10s, decomposition up to 20s, each oracle up to 2s, at most 8 iterations; all unchanged from baseline.
seeds: 17 for development cases; 29 for four fresh synthetic cases at 60s and a rolling Empire search repeat; 37 for four untouched final synthetic cases at 10s. Seed controls synthetic generation and CP-SAT; Empire mathematical inputs do not depend on the seed.
timing_caveat: Sequential solver runs. Earlier exploratory baseline-30 and baseline-repeat-30 runs had brief overlap with validation/aborted exploratory work; use elapsed as an observation, not a controlled speed ratio. Multiworker CP-SAT is nondeterministic. Final improved runs and 60s holdout comparisons run without other benchmark or test processes.

variants.transport-hints: Direct and potential resource-work bounds; complete verified hints; incumbent preservation; feasible master selections. No threshold packing or insertion; original oracle objective/core setup.
variants.transport-hints-cores: Adds satisfaction-based oracle and single-worker core extraction; preserves faster incumbents on reward ties.
variants.transport-packing: Adds count resources for demands > capacity/(k+1), k=1,2,3.
variants.improved: Adds independently verified pickup/delivery insertion and explicit bound/incumbent consistency guards. Used for 10/30-second and seed-29 holdout primary-search measurements.
variants.reviewed: Same primary search as improved; review fixes requested secondary duration refinement when a seed closes the proof without a primary assignment, and accounts for unsuccessful secondary solve time. Used for the longer pre-feedback Empire comparison.
variants.final: Adds strict-reward-progress feedback into the master and immediate closure against an existing verified incumbent. Original budgets unchanged. This is the committed source; evaluated on rolling Empire seeds 17/29 at 60s and fresh seed-37 synthetic instances at 10s.

reproduction: Use run_stress.py from this commit against either the package at baseline_commit or this commit, retaining the same cases, seed, workers and time limit. Earlier variant runs are exploratory observations identified by source hashes; the final-versus-baseline comparison is the reproducible release comparison.

validation.golden_benchmarks: frozen 250M/165M and locked Empire 58M/25.651527M; all proven optimal
